host.nvidia_smi_mode: device-wide memory.used at 1 Hz; per-process VRAM is N/A on this driver (--query-compute-apps returns N/A)

definitions.end_to_end: reference-set encoding + query-set scoring; excludes dataset construction, model loading, metric computation and result dump

stages.preprocess: CPU decode + resize/normalise to the method's own input tensor
stages.encode: every model forward pass (references and queries)
stages.score: encoder-output alignment + L2 normalisation, memory bank / coreset construction, query retrieval, method-specific map post-processing

definitions.repeat: 1 untimed warm-up + 3 timed repeats, median reported
definitions.peak_vram: torch.cuda.reset_peak_memory_stats() before each timed repeat, torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated() after; cross-checked against a 1 Hz device-wide nvidia-smi poll
definitions.protocols_are_native: each method keeps its own input protocol; 'same protocol' means the same measurement methodology

unit_set.reason: MPDD is the only dataset whose s0_k1 and s0_k4 conditions carry all six method columns in 05_baselines_multi_dataset/baseline_common_region.csv; the three categories are the first three in dictionary order of the frozen support manifest
